baseline.note: Planning estimate for whole-game production maturity, not a validation/acceptance claim.

planning_unit.name: MAJOR_PRODUCTION_DROP
planning_unit.definition: A coherent asset/code/data/documentation integration unit with a defined exit check. This is intentionally larger than an individual Git commit.
planning_unit.commit_count_rule: Do not use raw commit count as progress; one production drop may contain multiple commits and validation fixes.

waves.name: Runner and exact-head unlock
waves.goal: Restore reliable UE4.27.2 build/import/runtime validation without weakening gates.
exit: runner Engine Content ACL blocker removed or proven fixed

waves.name: Shire skeletal character visibility bridge
waves.goal: Put real skeletal humans/enemy QA stock on screen in P1C01 and prove the FBX/rig/AnimBP path.
exit: at least one real skeletal humanoid imported
at least one hostile skeletal rig imported for technical QA

waves.name: Shire natural vertical slice
waves.goal: Turn P1C01 into the first natural-looking complete gameplay slice.

waves.name: Part I core-cast skeletal production
waves.goal: Replace Part I named-cast proxies with production skeletal characters in priority order.

waves.name: Part I eight-region world production
waves.goal: Raise P1C01-P1C08 environments from prototype/foundation to coherent production worlds.

waves.name: Part I threats, audio and cinematic presentation
waves.goal: Finish the major encounter, sound and presentation layers for Fellowship.
exit: Nazgul/Orc/Uruk/Cave Troll/Watcher/Balrog/Lurtz production passes as applicable

waves.name: Part I acceptance lock
waves.goal: Close Fellowship as a production baseline before opening Part II runtime broadly.

waves.name: Part II runtime story and route construction
waves.goal: Open Two Towers runtime routes using source-verified screenplay/film continuity and existing systems.

waves.name: Part II production art, characters, battles and audio
waves.goal: Raise Part II from runtime-complete to production presentation.

waves.name: Part III runtime story and route construction
waves.goal: Open Return of the King runtime packages with scene-level source verification.

waves.name: Part III production art, characters, battles and audio
waves.goal: Raise Part III to production presentation and encounter quality.

waves.name: Trilogy integration and final acceptance
waves.goal: Finish the full-game experience instead of only finishing content creation.

guardrails: Percentages are planning weights, not evidence labels.
No wave may be promoted by warehouse staging alone.
Part II/III runtime remains gate-controlled; warehouse and preproduction may run earlier.
Heavy runtime assets remain soft/asynchronous and crowd-scale NPCs remain pooled.
Final animated characters are skeletal FBX with real rig/skin/deformation; static OBJ conversion is not character completion.
